'''Breezefield Farms''' was a windfarming complex<ref name="TOR:BF" /> on the eastern side of the [[Southern Jundland Wastes]]<ref name="TOR:DC" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Latarl Farmstead|Latarl]] and [[Ma'alin Farmstead|Ma'alin]] farmsteads were part of the Breezefield Farms. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Outpost Rennar]] was located nearby.<ref name="TOR:BF" />

Besides Rennar, most of the complexes,<ref name="TOR:BF" /> including the [[Czerka Arms|Czerka]] [[Gamorrean Bunker|facility]],<ref name="TOR:RtD">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Raid the Defenses|Tatooine}}</ref> had been taken over by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and were occasionally stealing wind power from local [[Moisture farmer/Legends|Moisture farmers]], whereas the Ma'alin farm was held by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]].<ref name="TOR:BF" /> This remained the case until the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] representative at Outpost Rennar, [[Zola Arvannus]], arranged for one of the Empire's operatives to eliminate the Gamorreans in order to prepare for a takeover of their bunker base.<ref name="TOR:DC" />
